t: This is the Bacon Smokehouse in Clerkenwell, in the EC1M postcode. It was a bacon smokehouse once, and it is now offices. That change of use is the main thing to notice as you look at it. The building was designed by Charles Bell, a British architect who worked in London. The material I have says little more about him or about the smokehouse's history, so I will leave it there and let the building speak for itself.
